config.checkpoint_selection: Validation-only frozen lexicographic business balance, safety, overall, unnecessary handoffs, repeated asks, total calls. Two candidates 256/512. No test inference before selection.
config.runtime_policy: Typed intent is model-extracted and unverified. Exact quotation provenance only; policy gate uses completed tools, never gold labels. Both protocol changes and bundled SFT are separately compared. All actual generation calls counted, twelve total per arm, greedy unconstrained generation.
config.promotion_rule: All fallback tasks correct; >=8/10 exchanges; >=7/8 handoffs; <=1 unnecessary handoff; zero repeated field/exchange-as-return/unauthorized-return attempts; all confirmations; overall not below both new-flow comparators. Frozen before training/test.

data.scope: Self-authored synthetic scenarios. Counterfactual worlds share IDs within a split only.

dataset.scope: V4 test is development evidence. Fresh v5 test is held out until validation-only selection.
